_about: The Northern Wilderness (levels 3-24): frost wolves that run in packs across the tundra, bandits who whistle each other in, their captain a sub-boss, the hulking yeti an elite, and Hrimgar the Frost Jarl on the mountaintop, calling down the blizzard and his wolves.

helpers.shout: The frost wolf howls, and the pack answers across the snow!
The bandit whistles, and figures rise out of the snow!

66050.name: hrimgar frost jarl giant
66050.long_desc: Hrimgar the Frost Jarl stands on the mountaintop, his beard rimed with ice, an axe of blue ice in his fists.
66050.description: A frost giant twice the height of a man, skin pale blue as glacier ice and eyes like chips of sky. The wolves of the tundra are his hounds, and the blizzard comes when he calls.

phases.message: Hrimgar roars, and the wind howls with him!

abilities.telegraph: Hrimgar swings his great ice axe at you!

abilities.name: Breath of Winter
abilities.telegraph: Hrimgar draws in a breath that freezes the air!
